method: Immutable current local production runtime; normal Marketplace installation, Start analysis, complete-case YAML input, Forms edits, Calculate/Recalculate, inspection and native exports. No DOM, storage, result or rule injection. This receipt does not claim runtime parity with the older public deployment.

calculationEntry.alt: The installed Plan a gift-kit commitment workflow is version 2.1.0 and offers Start analysis.
calculationEntry.caption: Start analysis creates a calculation case using this exact workflow release. Saved older reviews keep their own rules and execution policy.

calculationInputs.alt: The calculation workflow shows Calculate above Forms, with supplied inputs of 120 kits, a 1,440-minute deadline and a $600 budget.
calculationInputs.caption: This article supplies its fictional one-day case to the unchanged 2.1.0 workflow and plans ten minutes of rehearsal. Apply inputs records a value; Calculate runs the dependent assessments.

calculationSummary.alt: The current calculation’s decision summary supports the $300 internal complete correction with handoff at minute 40.
calculationSummary.caption: The completed calculation carries the evidence finding into planning and the decision summary. It records no answer acceptance, operating choice or authorization.

calculationEvidence.alt: The current evidence calculation supports both the printed-code and wrong-destination faults for the supplied kit configuration.
calculationEvidence.caption: The scoped observations establish the corrections planning must cover. Opening a result inspects the calculation; no acceptance step is required.

calculationPlanning.alt: The current planning calculation prefers internal replacement and journey repair at $300, with complete external correction available at $400.
calculationPlanning.caption: Both complete corrections pass under the confirmed one-day case. The cost-first workflow prefers $300 internal work; the case plans ten minutes under a five-minute minimum.

calculationSupporting.alt: The current workflow keeps configured supporting reports available beside its decision summary and calculations.
calculationSupporting.caption: Use Reports for the configured supporting views. Inspection and report navigation do not change the case or rerun its assessments.

calculationPending.alt: An unapplied $200 budget edit is flagged while the decision summary still describes the saved $600 case.
calculationPending.caption: An unfinished form edit does not silently change a finding. Apply or discard it before recalculating.

calculationStale.alt: After applying a $200 spending boundary, the calculation summary withdraws its current proposal until recalculation.
calculationStale.caption: The saved input now differs from the earlier planning basis. Recalculate reassesses the affected calculation; the old finding stays in history.

calculationBlocked.alt: Recalculation under the $200 limit finds no complete correction meeting the recorded requirements.
calculationBlocked.caption: The $100 and $180 partial fixes remain insufficient; the $300 and $400 complete packages exceed the changed boundary. A complete calculation can establish that no supplied option fits.

checks: Current 2.1.0 runs use calculation mode, supplied answers and zero review receipts; no reviewer identity or answer-state controls appear.
The published starter is retained unchanged with its original 60-minute deadline. The article explicitly supplies its separate one-day case and plans ten minutes without changing the minimum rule.
Calculate completes evidence before dependent planning and exposes their current results without acceptance records.

An unapplied budget edit disables Recalculate. Applying $200 makes planning stale and withdraws current support while preserving history. Recalculate reuses unchanged evidence and completes planning with no feasible complete correction.
The current workflow and focused result have no horizontal page overflow at 390px.
bounds: The current 2.1.0 calculation workflow is distinct from the separately authored v3 reviewed CLI/SDK clients and retained v2 mandatory-ten-minute authoring branch. All earlier artifacts and proofs remain unchanged.
